author_metadata_audit.interpretation: Name-string aggregation and fractional counting are exploratory only. Canonical author arrays are merged from sources, not trustworthy contribution-role ordering. Normalize candidates require evidence review.

quality_findings: These are exploratory catalogue/name-string counts, not audited distinct-person or final deduplicated-work rankings.

Some author arrays contain organizational credits and punctuation: Cosmos 3 (arxiv:2606.02800) and Isaac Lab (arxiv:2511.04831) include NVIDIA and a colon. Do not interpret array length as number of people.

Potential remaining cross-version duplicate: title:b7cfc97034350808bb66ca16 and arxiv:2509.07962 have matching eight-author bylines and titles differing by TA-VLA prefix. Flagged for review, not merged in this exploration.
Within the monthly cohort, 17 works have a technical_report manifestation; 15 have no personal author byline in the current catalogue.
47 additional included records pass a raw first_public_date string filter but have year-only precision and are absent from the audited monthly cohort; not assigned to a specific month here.

method.cohort: Union of work_ids from 12 published complete monthly snapshots; canonical work once globally.
method.identity: Exact author strings, NFC plus whitespace normalization only; NOT disambiguated people. Case, punctuation, accents, initials and name order preserved.
method.fraction: For sensitivity analysis only: sum 1 / number of distinct nonempty credited names per work. Collective credits may be in denominator; this is not contribution share.
method.peer: Canonical strict_peer_reviewed flag with currently blocked work excluded. Incomplete coverage, not actual author peer-reviewed output.
method.selected: Distinct work IDs referenced by existing executive, D and Q summaries. Editorial selection, not independent impact.
method.executive: Distinct work IDs supporting existing executive findings. Editorial selection, not independent impact.
method.first: First array position only, NOT verified first/equal/corresponding-author contribution.
